Name: TSQL_DATETIME_CORE
Feature: GETDATE(), SYSDATETIME(), DATEADD(datepart, number, date), DATEDIFF(datepart, startdate, enddate), DATETRUNC(datepart, date), EOMONTH(start_date [, month_to_add]), DATEFROMPARTS(year, month, day)
Description: Core T-SQL date and time functions for arithmetic, truncation, and construction.
GETDATE returns DATETIME; SYSDATETIME returns DATETIME2 with higher precision.
DATEDIFF counts boundary crossings, which may differ from elapsed-duration intuition.
DATETRUNC is SQL Server 2022+ and simplifies bucketed time aggregation.
EOMONTH is useful for month-end calculations without manual date math.
